summary: The behavioural gate passes, but the candidate fails the required Error Prone compile. At the exact head, ./gradlew :solr:core:compileJava -Pvalidation.errorprone=true fails with [ReferenceEquality] at RealTimeGetComponent.java:356: 'if (docFetcher == null || searcher != fieldSelectionSearcher)' and -Werror turns it into an error. The identifier fieldSelectionSearcher does not exist at base 78404ec8, so this head introduces the warning; the same file already suppresses ReferenceEquality where identity is intentional (lines 662 and 776). Fail-before is isolated and reproduces as required: the committed iteration fails at base with the missing nested related doc while val_i and marker pass, and the uncommitted iteration passes at base. At the candidate, pass-after passes with both iterations, all six suites pass with 120 tests and no failures/errors/skips, tidy exits 0 with a clean tracked tree, and root check -x test passes. The candidate tree and fork ref were unchanged before and after.

legs.fail_before_committed: failed as expected: base 78404ec8 + candidate test only, array {true}; 1 test completed, 1 failed, exit 1, 2026-11-20T16:15:33Z. AssertionError at xpath /response/doc/result[@name='related'][@numFound='1']/doc/str[@name='id'][.='44']; val_i and marker assertions passed, so the nested result is missing because the prefetched parent row lacks the unrequested stored subject used by {!terms f=subject v=$row.subject}.
legs.fail_before_uncommitted: passed (comparison): base + candidate test only, array {false}; 1 test completed, 0 failed, BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 1m49s, 2026-11-20T16:19:00Z. The isolated uncommitted iteration passes at the base; the r1 combined stock-run failure therefore belongs to the committed iteration, not to the uncommitted case.

legs.suites: passed: 120 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 0 skips across BasicFunctionalityTest 32, TestUnifiedSolrHighlighter 33, TestPseudoReturnFields 37, ReturnFieldsTest 16, TestRetrieveFieldsOptimizer 1, LargeFieldTest 1; 2026-11-20T16:25:41Z. XML archived before any further cleanTest.
